name: mockforge
observations: Powerful and elegant mock API tool built in Go with embedded web frontend
Designed to decouple frontend from backend development with instant mock endpoints, realistic faker data, latency simulation, and auth guards

name: golang-backend
observations: Pure Go single binary architecture using standard library net/http and lightweight router
Supports dynamic routing, template faker engine, stateful collections, latency simulation, auth guards, SSE live traffic, and OpenAPI 3.0 import/export

name: linear-frontend
observations: Modern dark-canvas web interface adhering to DESIGN.md (#010102 canvas, #0f1011 surface-1, #5e6ad2 lavender accent)
Includes Dashboard, Endpoint Studio, Stateful Collections, Live Traffic SSE Stream, Auth Playground, OpenAPI Hub, and Interactive Test Client

contents: Key strengths: zero external dependencies, embedded Linear SPA, high performance, robust faker and auto-CRUD collections

Identified improvement opportunities: route matcher O(N) pre-tokenization, workspace persistence on disk, async store flusher, conditional multi-scenarios, AI/LLM streaming mocks, and proxy record & replay mode
Supports first-match cascading rules based on query params, headers, route params, and JSON body paths
Full visual builder in Linear Endpoint Studio modal tabs with priority reordering, condition rows, and custom response templates
